name: codex-claude-council
description: ChatGPT (Codex CLI) and Claude (Claude Code) discuss your question until they agree, on your own subscriptions.
long_description:
Ask **ChatGPT** (through your Codex CLI) and **Claude** (through your Claude Code CLI) the same question. Each answers on its own, then they reply to each other, round after round, until both agree on one answer. No API keys: it runs the CLIs you have already signed in to.

- Both read your project in read-only mode (Claude in plan mode, Codex in its sandbox) and can search the web.
- Continue your existing Claude Code or Codex sessions, or take part yourself with `council_join`.
- Requires the Claude Code CLI and the Codex CLI to be installed and signed in on this computer.

tools.name: council_ask
tools.description: Ask ChatGPT and Claude; they reply to each other until both agree, then one writes the final answer and the other checks it.

tools.name: council_debate
tools.description: Run the council and return the whole discussion as JSON: both answers, every exchange and the final answer.

tools.name: council_ask_codex
tools.description: Ask Codex (ChatGPT) alone through the Codex CLI.

tools.name: council_ask_claude
tools.description: Ask Claude alone through Claude Code.

tools.name: council_join
tools.description: Take part in the council yourself, with the other model as the second member.

tools.name: council_turn
tools.description: Send your reply to the council's message when it is your turn.

tools.name: council_result
tools.description: Wait for the answer of a council that is still working.

tools.name: council_cancel
tools.description: Stop a council that is still working.
